'''Faye''' is a female [[NPC]] in {{Location|Capitoline Hill}}, talking with her daughter '''Linnea'''. 

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Faye''' This place has changed so much over the last twenty years... The last time your father and I visited was to watch the Agon.
:;'''Linnea''' The Agon? Who was the champion, Mom?
:;'''Faye''' Her name goes something like My... Strange, what was that girl's name again?
:;'''Faye''' I'm sorry, I can't remember all of a sudden. I just remember it was a young lady. 
{{Dialogue End}} 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Linnea:''' 
:Hmm? What's on your mind, Mom?

:'''Faye:''' 
:Just thinking about the news I saw last night. Something about that champion Gladiator everyone's talking about... Her name's [[Lupa]], right? She looks quite the warrior!
:I think so, too.

:{{DIcon}} Yep. Lupa's the best!
::'''Faye:''' 
::Wow, she even gets your seal of approval? Seems like there's a lot to look forward to, then.

:{{DIcon}} I'm stronger than she is.
::'''Faye:''' 
::Really? Well, I can't wait to see you in the finals, then!

:'''Faye:''' 
:I once visited Septimont to watch the [[Great Agon|Agon]] about twenty years ago. I don't remember most of the details, but I'll never forget the amazement I felt watching them compete.

:'''Linnea:''' 
:Mom, who was the champion twenty years ago? Was she as great as Lupa?

:'''Faye:''' 
:Hehe, I'd like to know as much as you do. I remember her name goes something like... My... My... Hmm? Strange, what was [[Mya|that girl's]] name? I can't remember all of a sudden..?

:'''Linnea:''' 
:...Mom?

:'''Faye:''' 
:Ah. Forgive me. I felt a bit light headed there for a moment. I need a bit of rest. I'll be better in no time.
{{Dialogue End}}
